title: fiberstate: calibrated per-molecule nucleosome and transcription-factor footprint calling for Fiber-seq
description: fiberstate labels every base of every Fiber-seq molecule as linker, nucleosome or transcription-factor footprint with a sequence-aware explicit-duration hidden semi-Markov model, calibrates footprint calls to a false-call rate, and tests co-binding of site pairs conditioned on accessibility. Includes the full benchmark against FiberHMM, fibertools-rs and HiddenFoot.
